thread:
sophie: Quick thread — UX + telemetry question: we need a dashboard pattern to compare canary vs baseline for short-lived traffic splits (5–10m). Thinking heatmap + fast drilldown. Ideas?

jamal: +1. Important: use percentile-based diffs (p50/p90/p95) not just means — means hide tail regressions.

alex: also add an "anchor cohort" selector so baseline can be a stable cohort (e.g., user_hash_mod). avoids skew from feature-flagged groups.

maria: UX idea: heatmap of metric distribution with side-by-side baseline overlay and a delta panel. Alerts should be two-step: visual band + explicit alert record. Suggested default: p95 delta > 15% AND min_samples > 500. :thinking_face: 

jamal: caveat: with tiny canaries (1–5%) min_samples won't hit 500. fallback rules: rolling window (30m) + bayesian shrinkage to avoid false positives.

sophie: UX question — should alerting live inline on the heatmap or be in a separate "guards" panel?

alex: inline band on the heatmap is better for discoverability + color-coded severity. also add an "open incident" CTA that pre-fills context. :bell:

maria: telemetry events we need: "rollout.metrics.snapshot", "rollout.slice.diff", "rollout.alert.triggered". include tags: model, rollout_id, split_pct, region, baseline_version.

jamal: API change proposal: add query param "anchor_cohort" to metrics endpoint. example: 
```
GET /api/rollouts/199/metrics?slice=browser:chrome&anchor_cohort=user_hash_mod:100
```
returns distribution buckets + counts + delta stats.

sophie: good. Also persist baseline epoch id so comparisons are stable even if baseline model updates. add TTL for persisted baselines (e.g., 7d).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment 199 started by @sophie — 2% traffic -> model:v2 (ingest_id=dbg-199-01)

alex: can we include ingest_id in the telemetry payload so the UI can link to raw samples?

maria: I'll mock the heatmap + drill GIF in Figma and attach. filing a lightweight ticket: RINF-4823 (UI + telemetry heatmap).

sophie: assignments: jamal -> telemetry backend (bayes shrinkage + anchor_cohort); alex -> UI overlay + incident CTA; maria -> figma + sample dataset. we'll validate with a staging run next Tue.

jamal: note for A/B tests: support weighted baselines across variants — propose a "baseline_union" mode that aggregates selected control variants with weighting.

alex: UI toggle: "normalize by baseline" vs "show absolute delta". default to normalized for fairness across metrics.

maria: show sample size calc in tooltip and expose raw counts next to p95 so users can judge noise.

sophie: config snippet for rollout guards (defaults): 
```
{
  "guard": {
    "p95_delta_pct": 15,
    "min_samples": 500,
    "rolling_window_minutes": 30,
    "bayes_shrink": true
  }
}
```

jamal: I'll prototype the shrinkage function and write unit tests with synthetic traffic. planning to PR telemetry + api change by EOW.

sophie: thanks — follow-ups: jamal drop PR link + test results here, alex create small FE ticket for overlay z-index quirk, maria drop figma link.

ops-bot: incident-bot: no incidents currently open.
